name: Buenaventura (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue with a double-width white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Buenaventura (bezants on blue and a tree on yellow).
history: The heraldic arms were officially approved on 10 December 1990 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 19 December 1990. The municipal flag, approved on 9 March 1993, is rectangular, of proportions 3:5, divided horizontally into three stripes, the central one twice the width of the outer ones, green above, white in the middle and blue below.
